title: Agent identity & confused deputy
summary: The tool credential can read the whole table. The signed-in user is Alice. A hijacked plan asking for everyone is a confused deputy — unless the executor binds customer_id from the session, not from the model.
takeaway: The agent's service identity is not the user's authorization. Scope comes from the session principal.
design_rule: Never let planner arguments widen access. Bind tenant and row scope from the authenticated session.
